requirements.title: Agent emits tmux navigation hint immediately after worktree_create succeeds
requirements.body: When the ADV agent creates a git worktree via worktree_create, it must immediately emit a navigation hint block telling the user how to reach the new tmux window. The hint must include: Ctrl+b n (next window), Ctrl+b l (last window), Ctrl+b w (interactive chooser), and oc switch (session switcher). The hint must appear before the agent continues inline implementation.

scenarios.title: Navigation hint emitted after successful worktree_create
given: The agent calls worktree_create and it succeeds
A new tmux window may have opened for the worktree
then: The agent emits a navigation hint block before any further tool calls
The hint includes Ctrl+b n, Ctrl+b l, Ctrl+b w, and oc switch
The hint states the worktree path and branch name
The hint states that implementation continues inline via workdir

scenarios.title: Navigation hint wording is consistent across all sources
given: adv-apply.md in the ADV repo contains the navigation hint block
ADV_INSTRUCTIONS.md in the ADV repo contains the navigation hint block
worktree-guide.md in openchad contains the navigation hint section
README.md in openchad contains the Worktree Flow section
scenarios.when: The canonical keybinds are compared across all four sources
then: All sources list the same four keybinds: Ctrl+b n, Ctrl+b l, Ctrl+b w, oc switch
No source references the non-existent oc window command

requirements.title: Worktree navigation guidance is documented in openchad user-facing docs
requirements.body: openchad must document worktree navigation keybinds in both the agent instruction file (worktree-guide.md) and the user-facing README. The AGENTS.md developer reference must also note the navigation hint section.

scenarios.title: worktree-guide.md contains Navigating to the New Worktree Tab section
then: A section titled 'Navigating to the New Worktree Tab' is present
The section contains a keybind table with Ctrl+b n, Ctrl+b l, Ctrl+b w, and oc switch

scenarios.title: README.md contains Worktree Flow section
given: README.md exists in the openchad repo
then: A section titled 'Worktree Flow' is present
The section contains the four navigation keybinds
